verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS research assistant, but the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only privacy-related item is an enterprise option to request removal of an organization's data, which is a different control from opting out of tracking and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
